name: Admin Document Folder Management
description: Admin manages folders in FolderManagerModal: create folder with parent selector (POST /api/document-folders/create/), inline rename (PATCH /api/document-folders/:id/update/), delete with confirmation (DELETE /api/document-folders/:id/delete/) and drag-reorder (POST /api/document-folders/reorder/). Existing admin-document-folders spec only covers parent pre-selection on create. The sidebar (FolderSidebar) also exposes a per-row trash icon, enabled on every folder: it opens DeleteFolderModal, which lists the folder inventory. On an empty folder the modal requires typing DELETE (case-sensitive) before confirming and offers archiving alongside; on a folder that still holds content it drops the destructive button entirely and presents archiving as the available action. The folder manager's own delete icon delegates to that same modal, so folder deletion has one contract everywhere.
knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 2): create/rename/delete + documents-blocking branch over mocked API. Drag-reorder intentionally not asserted (flaky in CI). Sidebar delete (DELETE-typed confirm, blocked icon, 409 conflict) added 2026-08-04. Rewritten 2026-08-11: the blocked-icon branch is gone (a filled folder now reaches the modal and is offered archiving), and the manager's inline confirmation panel was consolidated into DeleteFolderModal.
